description: Where each part's box sits on the map's coarse grid, [column, row]. Everything else the map draws -- box sizes, pin sides, districts, outlines, routes and bundles -- is computed from the model (apps/viewer/map.js; docs/DAG_TOPOLOGY.md, "The map"). The map is a second drawing of the same model, never a second model.

provenance.arrangement: Wide, like both sketches (Jeff's of 2026-11-10 and the strategy session's): the base body across the top row, the pitch plate body across the bottom row in the same order, the blade and the pitch link down the left, the tangential link alone between the two mounts. A bearing with no place of its own sits inside its link's outline.
provenance.symbols: The model has no interface word for a fastener pattern yet, so the one clocking constraint in v2 is named here; it is drawn as the ring of dots until the model carries the word.
